llm_proposer.assessment: The service loss was caused by a severe bidirectional loss on the 81.3 km fibre section represented by E8 in the S12→S15 direction and E19 in reverse, most likely a cable cut, crushed fibre, or damaged splice. Loss begins across exactly that physical section in both directions, while the upstream amplifiers remain powered normally.

proposals.rationale: O25 reports OSC loss on E8, O1/O66 show that light disappears at the first amplifier after it while the preceding amplifiers remain normal; O26 and O2 show the matching failure on reciprocal span E19, identifying the same physical cable section. Stable pump currents and normal upstream amplifier powers argue strongly against an amplifier failure.

Physical handling at this fibre section could affect both directions simultaneously. However, this mode should cause a brief excursion, whereas the sustained OSC and channel loss through t=1200 is characteristic of a large permanent span-loss increase.
